adoption_boundary: Binding only after WP-CTX-02 independent PASS + merge + successful DocSync.

coverage_policy.H1: Capsule the accepted boundary actually consumed by near-term H1; do not bulk-migrate H0 history.
coverage_policy.CITY: Boundary/navigation only. Product/spatial construction specifications remain mandatory exact reads and may not be compressed into capsule prose.
coverage_policy.PA: One capsule per COMPLETE PA workpack's canonical accepted result. Future PA DocSync adds the newly accepted result capsule before capsule-chain coverage can be declared complete. Missing result or capsule means coverage is incomplete; never infer from silence.

pa_accepted_result_chain.rule: Every WP-PA-NN whose Status is COMPLETE independently enters the chain universe; its canonical PA-NN.md result must exist and one indexed accepted capsule must point to that result.
